problem: Production Source Snapshot stopped immediately when a Git-linked Netlify build returned state=error, even though the workflow already contained an authorized canonical exact-source upload fallback.
root_cause: The linked-build branch only enabled fallback when error_message was exactly Skipped; other provider build errors exited 78 before the canonical transport could be attempted.
prevention: Always log linked deploy/build error evidence before fallback.
Any linked Netlify build state=error must set linked_fallback=true and continue to the canonical exact-source upload transport.
The fallback does not weaken safety: provider build state, exact production SHA identity, pricing content and production browser readback remain mandatory.
Never mark LIVE on linked-build trigger success alone.
For multiline workflow assertions, prefer explicit string/fragment assertions or construct RegExp from escaped strings; never place a literal newline inside a JavaScript regex literal.
Before projecting a new learning, syntax-check and execute its historical_replay test locally/in-lane; a prevention test that cannot parse is itself a delivery defect.

evidence.observed_error: Failed during stage 'building site': Build script returned non-zero exit code: 2

failed_approaches: The first regression encoded a cross-line assertion as a JavaScript regex literal containing a real newline, making the regression file itself unparsable under Node 22/24.
